docs/extensions.md:92:- **Wrap a tool or a section.** `wrapTool(tool, wrapper)` and `wrapSection(key, wrapper)` of pi-durable change a tool or a section, for example its description or its text. `wrapTool("read", (t) => ({ ...t, callers: ["tools"] }))` hides `read` from the model, but other tools can still call it (see [Tools the model sees](#tools-the-model-sees)).
docs/extensions.md:96:The `pi-action` extension has pi's system prompt sections. Use these keys with `wrapSection`: `preamble`, `tools`, `rules`, `project_context`, `available_skills`, and `cwd` (see [The system prompt](prompts.md#the-system-prompt)). For example, `wrapSection("rules", (s) => ({ ...s, render: () => "- My rule" }))` replaces pi's rules.
docs/skills.md:88:- The section comes from pi-action's built-in pi-durable extension, `pi-action`. A pi-durable extension can change it with `wrapSection("available_skills", ...)` (see [Override tools and sections](extensions.md#override-tools-and-sections)).
docs/prompts.md:25:pi-action leaves out pi's `docs` section, because it has no pi documentation. Extensions can change each section with `wrapSection(key, …)` (see [Override tools and sections](extensions.md#override-tools-and-sections)).
